description: This Swift source file defines enums, structs, and request/response models related to system capabilities, notifications, canvas geometry, and IPC communication for an application called OpenClaw. It includes definitions for various capabilities, notification priorities, canvas placement and status, request types for controlling UI elements, camera, and system actions, as well as related response structures. The file also includes serialization logic for converting requests to and from JSON.
